title: hello
description: First message on every connection: opens a new session or resumes one (protocol.md §5).

tools.description: Tools the client hosts. Names must be unique within the list.

input.description: Preferred format for audio the client will send.

output.description: Preferred format for audio the client will play.

sessionId.description: Present when resuming: the session to resume.

resumeFrom.description: With sessionId: the highest server seq the client has handled. Absent means 0.

capabilities.description: Optional capabilities the client supports. Absent means none.

context.description: Application data for the new session. Data, never instructions.

auth.description: A short-lived credential, sent here and never in the connection URL.
